title: Filipino-Style Potato Gratin with Garlic
description: A twist on the classic gratin, this dish combines the flavors of the Philippines with the comfort of a warm, cheesy potato casserole. Serve as a side dish or main course.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the Yukon Gold potatoes.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, minced garlic, and olive oil. Toss until the potatoes are evenly coated.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes. Sprinkle with some of the Filipino-Style Gravy Mix and some grated cheese.
Repeat the layering process until all the ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
